races.name: Gnome
races.description: Gnomes are brilliant, curious inventors whose optimism and ingenuity turn impossible ideas into practical marvels under pressure.

races.name: Gnomeregan Gnome
races.description: Gnomeregan gnomes preserve the classic tinker legacy: inventive minds, technical precision, and relentless hope after catastrophe.

races.name: Mechagnome
races.description: Mechagnomes pursue augmentation and perfection, fusing flesh with engineering to become hyper-efficient problem solvers.

races.name: Worgen
races.description: Worgen are disciplined souls wrestling with feral instinct, channeling predatory speed and righteous fury without losing control.
dataChips: "Maturity: late teens | Lifespan: human-like aging, long active years"

races.name: Void Elf
races.description: Void elves are exiled scholars of forbidden power, mastering inner chaos to weaponize the Void with focus instead of madness.
dataChips: "Maturity: around 60 | Lifespan: many hundreds of years"

races.name: Pandaren (Alliance)
races.description: Alliance pandaren blend contemplative balance with worldly conviction, carrying disciplined martial calm into larger global conflicts.

races.name: Night Elf
races.description: Night elves are ancient sentinels of nature and moonlight, graceful yet imposing guardians who unite druidic reverence with martial poise.

races.name: Dwarf
races.description: Dwarves are stout children of stone and forge, defined by clan loyalty, ancestral pride, and an unbreakable will beneath the mountains.

races.name: Ironforge Dwarf
races.description: Ironforge dwarves are steadfast traditionalists and master smiths, excelling through discipline, resilience, and timeless craftsmanship.

races.name: Wildhammer Dwarf
races.description: Wildhammer dwarves are sky-riding highland warriors attuned to storms and gryphons, valuing freedom, courage, and primal honor.

races.name: Dark Iron Dwarf
races.description: Dark Iron dwarves are cunning, volcanic survivors who wield shadowed sorcery and ruthless pragmatism forged in fire and conflict.

races.name: Draenei
races.description: Draenei are ancient exiles bound to faith and endurance, carrying luminous purpose, spiritual discipline, and cosmic perspective.

races.name: Broken Draenei
races.description: Broken draenei are scarred survivors severed from former grace, enduring through elemental grit, stubborn will, and hard-earned wisdom.

races.name: Exodar Draenei
races.description: Exodar draenei embody the sacred path of the Light, balancing compassion and conviction with calm heroic leadership.

races.name: Lightforged Draenei
races.description: Lightforged draenei are zeal-tempered holy crusaders, forged into living weapons against darkness through absolute devotion.

races.name: Human
races.description: Humans are adaptable and ambitious builders of kingdoms, defined by resolve, versatility, and the drive to leave a legacy within a short lifetime.

races.name: Alterac Human
races.description: Alterac humans are hard mountain survivors shaped by political collapse, known for pragmatic instincts and cold-weather grit.

races.name: Dalaran Human
races.description: Dalaran humans are arcane-leaning scholars and battlemagi, carrying a refined magical tradition rooted in learning and discipline.

races.name: Gilneas Human
races.description: Gilnean humans embody stern pride and survivalism, blending noble bearing with a fierce, self-reliant frontier spirit.

races.name: Kul Tiras Human
races.description: Kul Tiran humans are seafaring powerhouses raised by storms and steel decks, with a practical culture of sailors and marines.

races.name: Lordaeron Human
races.description: Lordaeron humans carry a tragic yet steadfast heritage, marked by faith, endurance, and loyalty under relentless hardship.

races.name: Stormwind Human
races.description: Stormwind humans represent the classic heroic ideal: disciplined soldiers, resilient citizens, and unwavering defenders of order.

races.name: Stromgarde Human
races.description: Stromgarde humans are martial traditionalists of the highlands, proud of old Arathor blood and relentless battlefield tenacity.

races.name: Tauren
races.description: Tauren are towering spiritual guardians of earth and sky, measured and wise but capable of overwhelming force when provoked.

races.name: Highmountain Tauren
races.description: Highmountain tauren are rugged peak-born wardens, shaped by harsh terrain, endurance culture, and ancestral mountain traditions.

races.name: Mulgore Tauren
races.description: Mulgore tauren reflect the classic tribal heart: honorable protectors rooted in plains tradition, ritual, and communal strength.

races.name: Taunka
races.description: Taunka tauren are cold-forged survivors of brutal climates, hardened by scarcity, resilience, and uncompromising pragmatism.

races.name: Blood Elf
races.description: Blood elves are refined arcane aristocrats balancing elegance and ambition, pursuing magical mastery with relentless intensity.
dataChips: "Maturity: around 60 | Lifespan: many hundreds of years"

races.name: Forsaken
races.description: Forsaken are undead survivors driven by grim autonomy, blending dark pragmatism, defiant will, and a refusal to kneel to fate.
dataChips: "Maturity: unchanged from life | Lifespan: ageless unless destroyed"

races.name: Forsaken Elf
races.description: Forsaken elves retain a sharp, haunted elegance beneath undeath, combining precision and bitterness into cold resolve.
dataChips: "Maturity: unchanged from life | Lifespan: ageless unless destroyed"

races.name: Forsaken Human
races.description: Forsaken humans carry echoes of old kingdoms into undeath, turning loss and vengeance into relentless determination.
dataChips: "Maturity: unchanged from life | Lifespan: ageless unless destroyed"

races.name: Nightborne
races.description: Nightborne are isolation-forged arcanists of ancient Suramar, wielding disciplined high magic with aristocratic poise.
dataChips: "Maturity: around 60 | Lifespan: many hundreds to over a thousand years"

races.name: Goblin
races.description: Goblins are explosive opportunists and brilliant dealmakers, thriving on risk, invention, and ruthless economic instinct.

races.name: Orc
races.description: Orcs are honor-driven warriors reborn from a brutal past, combining physical power with hard lessons about discipline and choice.

races.name: Hunter Clan Orc
races.description: Hunter-clan orcs are patient trackers of the wild, relying on ambush instinct, mobility, and deep fieldcraft.

races.name: Mystic Clan Orc
races.description: Mystic-clan orcs are spirit-guided visionaries who merge ancestral tradition with shamanic insight and ritual strength.

races.name: Warrior Clan Orc
races.description: Warrior-clan orcs are frontline conquerors of direct conflict, defined by ferocity, endurance, and battlefield dominance.

races.name: Pandaren (Horde)
races.description: Horde pandaren blend inner harmony with frontline determination, embracing hardship while preserving philosophy and craft.

races.name: Vulpera
races.description: Vulpera are clever desert nomads who survive through resourcefulness, adaptability, and tightly bonded caravan community.

races.name: Troll
races.description: Trolls are agile, fierce primal fighters bound to old rites and powerful regeneration, thriving through instinct and adaptability.

races.name: Forest Troll
races.description: Forest trolls are territorial ambushers of dense wilds, favoring brutal cunning, camouflage, and relentless close combat.

races.name: Ice Troll
races.description: Ice trolls are frozen-land hunters tempered by scarcity, combining savage endurance with ruthless survival tactics.

races.name: Jungle Troll
races.description: Jungle trolls are fast, ritualistic hunters of the deep wild, channeling agility, frenzy, and loa-rooted ferocity.

races.name: Zandalari Troll
races.description: Zandalari trolls are regal heirs of ancient empire, blending priestly power, martial discipline, and sovereign pride.

races.name: Arakkoa
races.description: Arakkoa are enigmatic avian mystics and hunters of spired ruins, balancing ritual wisdom with predatory precision.

races.name: Centaur
races.description: Centaur are relentless plains warbands built for speed, shock impact, and territorial dominance across open terrain.

races.name: Ethereal
races.description: Ethereals are energy-shrouded traders and arcane schemers, drifting between worlds through commerce and forbidden craft.

races.name: Furbolg
races.description: Furbolgs are spiritual wilderness guardians who combine primal resilience with deep ancestral reverence.

races.name: Gnoll
races.description: Gnolls are feral pack-raiders who overwhelm prey through chaotic aggression, mobility, and ruthless opportunism.

races.name: Leper Gnome
races.description: Leper gnomes are radiation-scarred survivors who weaponize unstable science and relentless improvisation.

races.name: Gilgoblin
races.description: Gilgoblins are savage coastal hunters adapted to tides, reefs, and violent undersea skirmishing.

races.name: Hobgoblin
races.description: Hobgoblins are militarized strategists who value rigid discipline, battlefield planning, and coordinated assault.

races.name: Half-Elf
races.description: Half-elves bridge mortal and elven worlds, thriving through versatility, social fluency, and cultural balance.

races.name: Hozen
races.description: Hozen are chaotic jungle tricksters who rely on agility, improvisation, and shameless audacity.

races.name: Vrykul
races.description: Vrykul are towering rune-marked warriors descended from titan-forged lines, feared for might and seafaring ferocity.

races.name: Jinyu
races.description: Jinyu are serene river-seers who interpret currents of water and fate, blending calm wisdom with fluid control.

races.name: Ankoan
races.description: Ankoan are disciplined deep-sea defenders hardened by endless war in dark waters and crushing depths.

races.name: Kobold
races.description: Kobolds are obsessive tunnel-dwellers whose survival depends on traps, teamwork, and crafty engineering.

races.name: Mogu
races.description: Mogu are ancient empire-builders of brutal order, wielding titan-wrought might and tyrannical discipline.

races.name: Naga
races.description: Naga are oceanic conquerors of cursed highborne blood, combining aristocratic cruelty with deadly aquatic mastery.

races.name: Ogre
races.description: Ogres are massive war-brutes who solve problems with raw force, intimidation, and stubborn battlefield endurance.

races.name: Quilboar
races.description: Quilboar are thorn-ridged survivalists of harsh badlands, thriving through brutality, endurance, and tribal spite.

races.name: Saberon
races.description: Saberon are savage feline hunters whose culture exalts dominance, speed, and predatory close-quarters violence.

races.name: Saurok
races.description: Saurok are engineered reptilian raiders built for ambush warfare, rapid strikes, and merciless pursuit.

races.name: Sethrak
races.description: Sethrak are serpentfolk of storm-swept deserts, balancing venomous precision with zealous temple tradition.

races.name: Yaungol
races.description: Yaungol are warlike bovine nomads shaped by fire-scarred frontiers, proud of endurance and relentless will.

races.name: Tortollan
races.description: Tortollans are ancient traveling lorekeepers who pair heavy-shell endurance with patient wisdom and tradecraft.

races.name: Blood Troll
races.description: Blood trolls are fanatical zealots of gore-soaked rites, channeling fear, frenzy, and primitive ritual violence.

races.name: Dark Troll
races.description: Dark trolls are elusive descendants of ancient troll lines, steeped in secrecy, shadowed forests, and primal cunning.

races.name: Tuskarr
races.description: Tuskarr are warm-hearted arctic seafarers who endure frozen oceans through cooperation, grit, and practical skill.

races.name: Nerubian
races.description: Nerubians are ancient spiderfolk strategists of subterranean empires, feared for cunning networks and ruthless planning.

races.name: Satyr
races.description: Satyrs are corrupted forest predators who weaponize seduction, ambush, and fel-tainted malice.

races.name: Felblood Elf
races.description: Felblood elves are blood elves twisted by demonic power, trading restraint for volatile magical hunger and cruelty.
dataChips: "Maturity: around 60 | Lifespan: many hundreds of years"

races.name: Nightfallen
races.description: Nightfallen are starved descendants of Suramar, clinging to identity through arcwine, discipline, and hard-earned survival.
dataChips: "Maturity: around 60 | Lifespan: many hundreds of years"

races.name: Wretched
races.description: Wretched are mana-warped outcasts consumed by magical deprivation, surviving through desperation, speed, and predatory instinct.
dataChips: "Maturity: around 60 | Lifespan: many hundreds of years"

races.name: San'layn
races.description: San'layn are vampiric undead aristocrats who rule through terror, blood magic, and chilling courtly cruelty.
dataChips: "Maturity: unchanged from life | Lifespan: ageless unless destroyed"

races.name: High Elf
races.description: High elves are disciplined descendants of Quel'dorei tradition, blending refined arcane scholarship with ranger precision.
dataChips: "Maturity: around 60 | Lifespan: many hundreds of years"

classes.name: Druid
classes.description: Druid class archetype for Warcraft-inspired character building.

classes.name: Balance Druid
classes.description: Balance druids are astral wardens who channel moonlight and starlight into devastating ranged spellcraft, weaving cosmic cycles into every battle.

classes.name: Feral Druid
classes.description: Feral druids become apex predators, embracing tooth, claw, and instinct to stalk prey and tear through enemies with savage precision.

classes.name: Guardian Druid
classes.description: Guardian druids embody ancient ursine resilience, transforming into colossal protectors that absorb punishment and anchor the front line.

classes.name: Restoration Druid
classes.description: Restoration druids are living conduits of renewal, mending wounds through verdant magic and sustaining allies through relentless conflict.

classes.name: Hunter
classes.description: Hunter class archetype for Warcraft-inspired character building.

classes.name: Beast Master Hunter
classes.description: Among the most gifted hunters, there are those who have from birth felt a profound bond with the creatures of the wild. These beast masters are drawn to the perilous primal world, invigorated by its dangerous and untamed nature. Primitive landscape becomes home. Ferocious predator becomes kin.

classes.name: Marksman Hunter
classes.description: Marksman hunters are peerless sharpshooters who end fights from impossible range, turning patience, positioning, and flawless aim into lethal artistry.

classes.name: Survival Hunter
classes.description: Survival hunters thrive at the edge of danger, blending traps, grit, and close-quarters ferocity to dominate untamed battlefields.

classes.name: Mage
classes.description: Mage class archetype for Warcraft-inspired character building.

classes.name: Arcane Mage
classes.description: Arcane mages pursue pure magical theory, bending raw arcana into elegant, high-impact spellcraft that rewards precision and control.

classes.name: Frost Mage
classes.description: Frost mages rule tempo and space, freezing foes in place while methodically overwhelming them with unrelenting glacial power.

classes.name: Fire Mage
classes.description: Fire mages are explosive battle virtuosos, chaining ignition and critical bursts into cascading infernos that consume entire encounters.

classes.name: Monk
classes.description: Monk class archetype for Warcraft-inspired character building.

classes.name: Brewmaster Monk
classes.description: Brewmaster monks are unshakable brawlers, redirecting pain through disciplined brewing arts and turning chaos into controlled resilience.

classes.name: Mistweaver Monk
classes.description: Mistweaver monks fuse martial grace with restorative mists, preserving allies through fluid movement and tranquil spiritual focus.

classes.name: Windwalker Monk
classes.description: Windwalker monks are relentless combat dancers, combining speed, timing, and chi-infused strikes into elegant, crushing offense.

classes.name: Paladin
classes.description: Paladin class archetype for Warcraft-inspired character building.

classes.name: Holy Paladin
classes.description: Holy paladins are radiant battle-healers who uphold allies with sacred miracles while standing firm amid the fiercest pressure.

classes.name: Protection Paladin
classes.description: Protection paladins are stalwart bulwarks of faith, shielding companions through consecrated defenses and unwavering resolve.

classes.name: Retribution Paladin
classes.description: Retribution paladins are zealous avengers, delivering righteous judgment through decisive weapon strikes empowered by divine wrath.

classes.name: Priest
classes.description: Priest class archetype for Warcraft-inspired character building.

classes.name: Discipline Priest
classes.description: Discipline priests master balance between absolution and punishment, weaving preventative wards and atonement-fueled offense.

classes.name: Holy Priest
classes.description: Holy priests are devoted restorers of life, channeling pure grace to stabilize allies and reverse catastrophic damage.

classes.name: Shadow Priest
classes.description: Shadow priests embrace forbidden whispers, weaponizing void insight and mind-breaking pressure to unravel enemy will.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.description: Rogue class archetype for Warcraft-inspired character building.

classes.name: Assassin Rogue
classes.description: Assassin rogues are patient executioners who exploit poison, timing, and precision to eliminate targets before retaliation is possible.

classes.name: Outlaw Rogue
classes.description: Outlaw rogues are daring skirmishers, thriving on audacity, dirty tricks, and relentless momentum in chaotic melee exchanges.

classes.name: Subtlety Rogue
classes.description: Subtlety rogues are masters of the unseen strike, flowing through shadows to control engagements and deliver surgical finishers.

classes.name: Shaman
classes.description: Shaman class archetype for Warcraft-inspired character building.

classes.name: Elemental Shaman
classes.description: Elemental shamans command storm, flame, and earth from range, unleashing volatile natural forces with disciplined ritual control.

classes.name: Enhancement Shaman
classes.description: Enhancement shamans are primal weapon mystics, infusing steel with elemental fury for explosive close-range pressure.

classes.name: Restoration Shaman
classes.description: Restoration shamans are tidecallers of recovery, sustaining groups through ancestral rites, totems, and flowing restorative currents.

classes.name: Warlock
classes.description: Warlock class archetype for Warcraft-inspired character building.

classes.name: Affliction Warlock
classes.description: Affliction warlocks are patient tormentors who spread ruinous curses and drain life over time until resistance collapses.

classes.name: Demonology Warlock
classes.description: Demonology warlocks marshal infernal legions, overwhelming enemies through strategic summoning and controlled demonic force.

classes.name: Destruction Warlock
classes.description: Destruction warlocks are engines of catastrophic power, converting volatile fel energy into annihilating bursts.

classes.name: Warrior
classes.description: Warrior class archetype for Warcraft-inspired character building.

classes.name: Arms Warrior
classes.description: Arms warriors are disciplined weapon masters, reading battle flow and delivering devastating, perfectly timed blows.

classes.name: Fury Warrior
classes.description: Fury warriors embrace relentless aggression, turning pain and momentum into overwhelming dual-weapon assault.

classes.name: Protection Warrior
classes.description: Protection warriors are immovable defenders, using shield technique and battlefield command to absorb and control threats.

classes.name: Death Knight
classes.description: Death Knight class archetype for Warcraft-inspired character building.

classes.name: Frost Death Knight
classes.description: Frost death knights channel icy ruin through runeblades, combining chilling control with crushing martial execution.

classes.name: Blood Death Knight
classes.description: Blood death knights are vampiric juggernauts, sustaining through grievous punishment and dark sanguine mastery.

classes.name: Unholy Death Knight
classes.description: Unholy death knights command plague and undeath, grinding down foes with relentless diseases and necrotic armies.

classes.name: Demon Hunter
classes.description: Demon Hunter class archetype for Warcraft-inspired character building.

classes.name: Havoc Demon Hunter
classes.description: Havoc demon hunters are acrobatic slayers, using speed and fel-infused aggression to shred priority targets instantly.

classes.name: Vengeance Demon Hunter
classes.description: Vengeance demon hunters are infernal wardens, enduring extreme pressure while punishing enemies with demonic retaliation.

classes.name: Wrath Demon Hunter
classes.description: Wrath demon hunters embody unrestrained fel fury, converting pain and hatred into surging offensive power.
